meta.description: A thin skin between two attachments, like the veil between the cap margin and the stipe. It tears along a ragged line: the part on b falls into a skirt (the ring), the part on a stays as a fringe. Gives the skin as strands that run across it, to mesh with the rest, and as a thin sheet mesh, which stays sharp at any mesh resolution.

a.description: The first attachment, e.g. the margin of a cap. Points in a row (a ring when they go around) or paths.

b.description: The second attachment, e.g. the stipe. A ring of points in a wraps around a path here, other attachments are joined as they are.

attachment.description: Where the membrane wraps around a path in b: 0 = level with a, 1 = the tip of the path, -1 = its base

anchor.description: Holds the membrane on a path in b this far from its base, measured along it, instead of following a with attachment. It stays put while b grows and a moves, like the ring of a mushroom whose stipe lengthens above it. 0 = attachment places it.

along.description: Holds the membrane on a path in b at this share of its length from its base, like a ring in the upper third of a stipe at 0.7. It keeps that share while b grows, so a longer stipe keeps its ring in the upper third. 0 = anchor or attachment places it.

sag.description: How far the middle of the skin hangs below the line between the attachments, as a share of their distance

tear.description: How far it has torn: 0 = intact, at 0.5 it has torn all the way round, at 1 the parts hang free

tear_position.description: Where it tears, 0 = at b (the stipe), 1 = at a (the margin)

torn_length.description: How long the skin was when it tore. The torn parts share this length by tear_position and keep it while a and b move further apart, so a ring stays short while the cap opens. 0 = the parts stretch with the distance between a and b.

flare.label: Flare of the torn parts
flare.description: How a torn part hangs, from where it is attached (left) to its torn edge (right): 0 = straight down, 1 = straight out towards the other side

strands.description: Strands across the skin. Neighbours touch when there are about as many as the longer attachment is long in thicknesses.

resolution_curve.description: Points along a strand from one attachment to the other, torn parts get their share
